title: 第1007章 通冥宝镜第1006章 雷电宝器
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
帝子云的正道雷发，乃万古闻所未闻传奇，九道雷发历经七七四十九天，仿佛一道雷发一重天。
而九九八十一天后，他的金光武巢气海雷电本源大峡谷初具规模。
正在他兴奋的差一点跳脚时，第九十九层雷电云层在消散，同时，雷电本源大峡谷也在消散。
证明属于他的雷发正道结束，他成为天地间万古以来最强半神，雷电星君，雷电奥义主宰。
然，他慌急了，如此天道混沌瑰宝，他整体还没有炼化融合九牛一毛呢，如此重宝过了这村可没有这寨。
他怎么能眼睁睁的看着属于他的天道混沌瑰宝隐退消散。
“喂喂喂，娘希屁滴，不讲道义啊，咋就消散了？看我天遁地吞，看我一飞冲天，追！”
对他来说，这是属于他的正道雷发，那就一丝一毫皆属于他。
故，最强半神的他带着电光闪烁的魔龙黑翼连续展翅紧追不舍，如今魔龙黑翼波动展翅一飞便是十万里，瞬间到达，速度打破半神古往今来，然，不仅仅如此。
而雷发越升越高，逐渐隐没于属于正神虚空，然，帝子云根本不信邪，展翅魔龙黑翼便追进了正神虚空【神灵虚空】。
然，他发现仓促了，大意了，过火了。
“阿妈呀，这啥风？转眼间便没有日月星辰，暗无天日黑洞洞，犹如大阴间。
风吹着鼻涕哗啦啦啦，身躯要被吹化，难道本主跟着正道雷发进入了红叶师尊说的正神才能进入的神灵虚空？”
帝子云慌急了，他只感觉进入了浩瀚漆黑空间，啥都没有。
他的灵魂被虚空空寂风吹到冰彻寒骨，脑浆发冻，半神体以及魂魄皆在松软风化。
能让帝子云喊阿妈呀的不是得到混沌级瑰宝，就是碰上威胁生命超级难题。
显然帝子云遇上后者。
然，他仍然对着消散的正道雷发紧追不舍，他舍不得啊，到了嘴边的混沌瑰宝溜了他真的会寝食难安。
然，估计追了数亿里后，正在神灵虚空隐没消散的正道雷发雷电云层好像浮起一樽金铜玉境，金铜玉镜全名【混沌之光雷电通冥宝镜，乃混沌开天辟地诞生之重宝】
通冥宝镜自雷电云层浮起上升的那一刻，如同混沌无极之光，霎那间晃晕帝子云的阴阳星瞳。

一刹那眼黑之间，如同圣尊仙光照亮漆黑神灵虚空，一派祥和祥光福瑞。
帝子云仿佛来到了大草原，呼延娜娜公主便是灵汐，他们青梅竹马情投意合乃金童玉女，每日琴棋书画，大草原策，马奔腾有了鱼水之欢，而后儿孙满堂。
而桑吉温婉如水抚琴暖床，他们终于珠联璧合延续了香火，桑吉的爱真的梦想成真，郎情妾意定格万载沧海桑田永恒，不离不弃。
她们父母膝下儿孙满堂，全部得道成仙寿与天齐，芸姬妹妹每日快乐逗着小可爱，快乐源泉不亦乐乎。
他们飘飘欲仙翻云覆雨便打造爱琴河飞舟扬帆起航畅游星海星河。
在无尽温柔乡，他的宝剑生锈，而沉迷于天伦之乐的他无动于衷。
然，他的数之不尽意念魂魄大军却开始撕逼；“这是梦幻世界，赶紧醒来，否则死于神灵虚空空寂风。”
“为什么要醒？人生本就一场梦，梦醒一场空，故而永远不要醒来，即使没有身体，还有完美梦境。
梦境便能美梦成真一切美好。”
而处于通冥宝镜幻境的帝子云那些分身便代表他的思维，但最终梦醒的一派占据绝对主力。
content_en:
The thunder of Emperor Ziyun's righteous path is a legend that has never been heard of in the ages. The nine thunders lasted for seventy-seven forty-nine days, like one thunder that spanned the sky.
And ninety-nine and eighty-one days later, his Golden Light Martial Chao, Qi Sea, Thunder Origin Grand Canyon began to take shape.
Just when he almost jumped in excitement, the ninety-ninth layer of thunder and lightning clouds was dissipating, and at the same time, the Grand Canyon where the thunder and lightning originated was also dissipating.
It proved that his rightful path of thunder and lightning was over, and he became the strongest demigod in the world in all eternity, Lord of Thunder and Lightning Star, and Lord of Thunder and Lightning Mysteries.
However, he panicked. He had not yet refined and integrated such a treasure of chaos from heaven. There was no such treasure in this village.
How could he just watch the chaos treasure that belonged to him recede and dissipate.
"Hey, hey, hey, Mommy, you are so unethical, why did you just disappear? Watch me escape from the sky and swallow the earth, watch me fly into the sky, chase me!"
For him, this is his rightful thunder, and every bit of it belongs to him.
Therefore, he, the strongest demigod, chased after him with the electric dragon's black wings continuously spread out. Now the magic dragon's black wings spread out in waves and flew a hundred thousand miles. He arrived in an instant, and his speed was faster than that of demigods in the past. However, it was not just that.
The thunder rose higher and higher, gradually disappearing into the void belonging to the righteous god. However, Di Ziyun did not believe in evil at all, and the black wings of the demon dragon spread out and chased into the void of the righteous god [the void of the gods].
However, he found that he had been hasty, careless, and overdone.
"Mom, what kind of wind is this? In the blink of an eye, there is no sun, moon or stars, and the sky is dark and dark, like the Great Underworld.
The wind blows the nose and the body is about to be blown away. Could it be that the master has followed the righteous thunder and entered the spiritual void that Master Hongye said can only be entered by the righteous gods? "
Di Ziyun panicked. He only felt that he had entered a vast dark space and there was nothing there.
His soul was blown to the bone by the silent wind of the void, his brain was frozen, and his demigod body and soul were softening and weathering.
What makes Di Ziyun cry "Ama" is either getting a Chaos-level treasure or encountering a life-threatening super problem.
Apparently Di Ziyun met the latter.
However, he still chased after the dissipated Zhengdao Leifa. He couldn't bear to let it go. He would really have trouble sleeping and eating when the treasure of chaos slipped away from his mouth.
However, after chasing for hundreds of millions of miles, the thunder and lightning clouds of Zhengdao that were disappearing in the void of the gods seemed to float a bottle of gold, copper and jade. The full name of the gold, copper and jade mirror is [the mirror of light, thunder and lightning of chaos, which is the important treasure born from the creation of chaos]
The moment the Tongming Treasure Mirror floated up from the thunder clouds, it was like the endless light of chaos, instantly dazzling the yin and yang star pupils of Emperor Ziyun.
In the blink of an eye, it was like the divine light illuminating the dark spiritual void, creating a peaceful and auspicious light.
Di Ziyun seemed to have arrived in the prairie, and Princess Huyan Nana was Lingxi. They were childhood sweethearts who fell in love and became a golden girl. They played chess, calligraphy and painting every day, played in the prairie, had fun with horses galloping, and then had children and grandchildren.
And Sangji was as gentle as water playing the piano and warming the bed. They finally became a perfect match and continued their incense. Sangji's love dream came true, and the lover's love for the concubine was fixed for eternity through the vicissitudes of life, never leaving.
Their parents are full of children and grandchildren, all of whom have attained immortality and lived as long as heaven. Sister Yunji is happy and teasing the little cutie every day, and her happiness is endless.
They were so excited that they built an Aegean flying boat and set sail to travel across the stars and seas.
In the Land of Endless Tenderness, his sword was rusty, but he was indifferent as he was addicted to family happiness.
However, his countless army of thoughts and souls began to fight; "This is a dream world, wake up quickly, otherwise you will die in the empty wind of the void of the gods."
"Why wake up? Life is a dream, and waking up from the dream will be empty, so never wake up. Even if there is no body, there is still a perfect dream.
Dreams can make all good things come true. "
The clones of Di Ziyun in the illusion of Tongming Baojing represent his thoughts, but the group that finally woke up from the dreamOccupy the absolute main force.
